انسلبوا (form VII)
# اِنْسَلَبُوا (insalabū) /in.sa.la.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
# اِنْسَلِبُوا (insalibū) /in.sa.li.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
